newsitem.title: FRANCE: French shares post strong gains on dlr, government.
newsitem.headline: French shares post strong gains on dlr, government.

text.p: French shares posted strong gains in the morning on a firm dollar and driven by the futures market on technical reasons, dealers said.

The nomination of a left-wing government on Wednesday evening, with a Communist Transport minister, did not make a big difference to the market but investors were reassured on the government's commitment to the euro with the naming of Dominique Strauss-Kahn as finance minister, dealers said.
Brokers added investors were awaiting the government's policy statements. The first cabinet meeting started on Thursday morning.
* Sanofi, up 5.04 percent at 542 francs, boosted by Wednesday's bullish profit forecast.
* Accor, up 2.38 percent at 859, underpinned by results outlook and 2.18 percent stake by George Soros.
* CAC-40 index up 56.65, or 2.15 percent, at 2,692.02 at 0825 GMT. It had hit a day high of 2,693.32.
* CAC-40 Jun futures 2,670 vs 2,614 at Wednesday's close.
